title: Delegation worktree removal deletes ignored non-build content and reports a partial Windows removal as retained
outcome: Reclaiming a clean delegation worktree never silently deletes child-written ignored evidence or logs (.logs/, .evidence/, .tmp/) or pulls the cwd from under processes the child left running, and a removal that fails partway is reported as a partial removal rather than as an intact retained worktree.
acceptance: Delegation worktree removal deletes ignored non-build content and reports a partial Windows removal as retained is done
